description: Create bash equivalents for all PowerShell monitoring and management scripts, with comprehensive tests using bats (Bash Automated Testing System)

userStories.title: Create ralph-utils.sh shared library
acceptanceCriteria: Implement get_ralph_paths() function returning script paths
Script is POSIX-compatible with bash extensions
All functions are documented with comments
userStories.notes: Mirror RalphUtils.psm1 functionality. Use jq for JSON parsing.

userStories.title: Create ralph-status.sh script
acceptanceCriteria: Display banner with current git branch
Show progress bar using Unicode block characters
Display story table with ID, Priority, Status, Title columns
List incomplete stories sorted by priority
Handle missing prd.json gracefully with helpful message
userStories.notes: Match ralph-status.ps1 output format and functionality

userStories.title: Create ralph-locks.sh script
acceptanceCriteria: Implement 'status' command showing all current locks
Implement 'release -s STORY_ID' command for single lock
Implement 'cleanup' command for stale locks (>2 hours)
Display lock owner, age, and status (valid/stale/dead)
userStories.notes: Match ralph-locks.ps1 commands and output format

userStories.title: Create ralph-cleanup.sh script
acceptanceCriteria: Implement '-d/--dead' flag to clean dead instances
Implement '-o/--old' flag to clean old instances (>7 days)
Implement '-a/--all' flag for both dead and old
Show instance summary (total, running, completed, terminated, dead)
Release locks held by dead instances during cleanup
userStories.notes: Match ralph-cleanup.ps1 functionality. Respect RALPH_CLEANUP_TTL env var.

userStories.title: Create ralph-dashboard.sh TUI script
acceptanceCriteria: Display header with PRD progress bar
Show instance table: ID, Story, State, Iteration, Runtime, Branch
Show active locks section with owner and age
Support keyboard shortcuts: q=quit, r=refresh, l=locks, c=cleanup
Use Unicode box drawing characters for TUI frame
Color-coded instance states (green=working, cyan=claiming, yellow=idle, red=dead)
userStories.notes: Match ralph-dashboard.ps1 layout. Use tput for terminal control.
